operations.title: Coprime cyclic monodromy has Adams survivor spectrum gcd(n,p m)=1
operations.statement: For G=F_p^r semidirect C_m with faithful cyclic action of order m prime to p, power operations commute with all coefficient fiber sums and basis-level fiber lifts iff gcd(n,p*m)=1.
operations.scope: Elementary-abelian kernel, faithful cyclic coprime action, algebraic correspondence only.

operations.title: Three-family coprime cyclic monodromy spectrum test
operations.protocol: Exhaust every quotient fiber and n=1..24 for A4->C3, C3 semidirect C2->C2, and C5 semidirect C4->C4; compare global compatibility to gcd(n,p*m)=1.
operations.falsifier: Any family/index disagrees with the gcd classification.
